items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I did another show with Terry Gibby's band, oh, a great band. For two years we did a show called Operation Entertainment.

ctx.x: But no more. It was just that's out, you know. But as I say this was very rewarding, being with Bobby, and getting a chance to play, and getting the exposure. And consequently as I said I did quite a few recordings, and I got into quite a bit of TV work as a result of that. I did the Lucy Show, and the Bill Cosby Show, This is Your Life, I did another show with Terry Gibby's band, oh, a great band. For two years we did a show called Operation Entertainment.
